topMovers.vulnerabilityName: Tenda AC1900 Router AC15 Model Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
topMovers.shortDescription: Tenda AC1900 Router AC15 Model contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows remote attackers to execute system commands via the deviceName POST parameter.

topMovers.vulnerabilityName: Tenda AC11 Router Stack Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
topMovers.shortDescription: Tenda AC11 devices contain a stack buffer overflow vulnerability in /goform/setmac which allows attackers to execute code via a crafted post request.

topMovers.vulnerabilityName: Yealink Device Management Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) Vulnerability
topMovers.shortDescription: Yealink Device Management contains a server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability that allows for unauthenticated remote code execution.

topMovers.vulnerabilityName: Zoho ManageEngine Desktop Central File Upload Vulnerability
topMovers.shortDescription: Zoho ManageEngine Desktop Central contains a file upload vulnerability that allows for unauthenticated remote code execution.
ThinkPHP "noneCms" contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution through crafted use of the filter parameter.

topMovers.vulnerabilityName: vBulletin PHP Module Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
topMovers.shortDescription: The PHP module within vBulletin contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution via the widgetConfig[code] parameter in an ajax/render/widget_php routestring request.

topMovers.vulnerabilityName: Progress Telerik UI for ASP.NET AJAX and Sitefinity Cryptographic Weakness Vulnerability
topMovers.shortDescription: Progress Telerik UI for ASP.NET AJAX and Sitefinity have a cryptographic weakness in Telerik.Web.UI.dll that can be exploited to disclose encryption keys (Telerik.Web.UI.DialogParametersEncryptionKey and/or the MachineKey), perform cross-site-scripting (XSS) attacks, compromise the ASP.NET ViewState, and/or upload and download files.
Unraid contains a vulnerability due to the insecure use of the extract PHP function that can be abused to execute remote code as root. This CVE is chainable with CVE-2020-5849 for initial access.

topMovers.vulnerabilityName: WordPress File Manager Plugin Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
topMovers.shortDescription: WordPress File Manager plugin contains a remote code execution vulnerability that allows unauthenticated users to execute PHP code and upload malicious files on a target site.

topMovers.vulnerabilityName: SonicWall SSLVPN SMA100 SQL Injection Vulnerability
topMovers.shortDescription: SonicWall SSLVPN SMA100 contains a SQL injection vulnerability that allows remote exploitation for credential access by an unauthenticated attacker.

highestSignals.vulnerabilityName: Cisco Identity Services Engine Incorrect Use of Privileged APIs Vulnerability
highestSignals.shortDescription: Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE) and Cisco ISE Passive Identity Connector (ISE-PIC) contain an incorrect use of privileged APIs vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to gain unauthorized access to the affected device by bypassing the web-based management interface.

highestSignals.vulnerabilityName: Cisco Secure Email Gateway SQL Injection Vulnerability
highestSignals.shortDescription: Cisco AsyncOS software for Cisco Secure Email Gateway (SEG) contains a SQL injection vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to execute arbitrary commands with root privileges on the underlying operating system.

Linux Kernel contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the ebtables SNAT target which allows an ARP sender hardware address rewrite to write directly into a nonlinear socket-buffer fragment backed by a splice-imported file page. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version.
Google Pixel devices contain an improper authorization vulnerability in the cellular modem. A logic error may allow an attacker to bypass permission checks and escalate privileges.

highestSignals.vulnerabilityName: Linux Kernel Improper Check for Unusual or Exceptional Conditions Vulnerability
highestSignals.shortDescription: Linux Kernel contains an improper check for unusual or exceptional conditions vulnerability in the TLS receive path which allows a zero-length record retrieved from the rx_list to bypass the intended recvmsg() record-type handling, potentially causing subsequent TLS records to be processed using incorrect zero-copy and queuing assumptions. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version.

Linux Kernel contains a race condition vulnerability which allows concurrent writes to the same AF_ALG socket causing data to be unpredictably interleaved and creating inconsistencies in the socket's internal state.

highestSignals.vulnerabilityName: Acronis Backup Incorrect Default Permissions Vulnerability
highestSignals.shortDescription: Acronis Backup plugin for cPanel & WHM and extension for Plesk contains an incorrect default permissions vulnerability that could allow for privilege escalation.
